rationale.A25276-zh-00042: 수수료 table header; use 手续费 consistently with neighboring 시행령 제17조제1항 fee column.
rationale.A25276-zh-00043: 이상인 경우에는 공장별로 첨부합니다): finishes prior split condition and requires per-factory attachments, not factory installation.
